subject.title: [Feature]: Control console session list should show full date

question: Should the Sessions Updated column switch from relative text to direct full date/time, and should maintainers adopt the open fork PR or replace it with a fresh same-repo implementation?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the requested display format is a user-facing UX policy choice and an open conflicting fork PR already attempts the change.

options.title: Adopt full date/time display
options.body: Proceed with a narrow full local date/time display, preserving localized fallback and relative hover context, either by rebasing the fork PR or replacing it in-repo.

options.title: Keep relative display
options.body: Close the linked implementation path and this request if maintainers prefer compact relative Updated values in the session list.

options.title: Fold into broader Sessions UX
options.body: Keep this open only as part of a larger Sessions table redesign if maintainers do not want a one-off column change now.

recommendation.title: Adopt full date/time display
recommendation.body: Proceed with a narrow full local date/time display, preserving localized fallback and relative hover context, either by rebasing the fork PR or replacing it in-repo.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-main ownership signal for the Sessions page and recent Control UI table behavior.
